Initial release of **rank-tracker**: a comprehensive keyword ranking and SERP/AI visibility analysis skill.

- Tracks keyword rankings over time in both classic search results and AI-generated overviews.
- Detects ranking movements, identifies trends, and provides alerts on significant position changes.
- Supports competitor benchmarking, SERP feature tracking, and GEO/AI citation visibility.
- Offers structured templates for setting up tracking, reporting ranking snapshots, analyzing trends, and producing stakeholder-ready reports.
- Works with automated rank data (from SEO/search/AIs) or manual user input.
